subject: Rename cli benchmark check-aof and check-rdb src and object files to valkey respectively (#188)
reason: The change only renames source files (redis-cli.c, redis-benchmark.c, redis-check-rdb.c, redis-check-aof.c to valkey-* names, all 100% similarity renames with no content change) and updates the Makefile object-file lists and comments accordingly. The compiled binaries keep their existing names and identical code, so there is no behaviour change in the server, the tools, replication or persistence to exercise; any build breakage would already surface when the runner compiles the build. No scenario is needed.
